<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== CROSSING REPAIR V2 - EVERY MAP CENSUSED, THE VOLUME FIXED WHERE IT LIVES (Job 356s editor census of the persistent VEILDistrict level found no column actor, and job 361s GameMode read explains the terrain: on placed maps the WorldBuilder stands down, so the district is the placed geometry itself - and job 351s seating read names the rest: ADistrict streams sublevels in and out by distance at runtime. Job 347s runtime census saw StaticMeshActor_0 because in game the streamed levels stand loaded; the editor session that opened only the persistent level never saw it. The volume lives in a streaming sublevel. THIS JOB censuses EVERY map asset in the merged base one at a time - load, count actors, print every static-mesh actor whose bounds contain the spawn column, set NO_COLLISION on exactly the mega-volume matches (top above 1000, base below 0), save that level - with a backup of every map first. Per-map prints name where the volume lives. If no map carries a match, the census itself is the reroute read and nothing is edited.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 8) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STILL OPEN after 2 min - job deferred.'; Write-Output 'JOB 363 DEFERRED'; return }
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$maps = Get-ChildItem "$base\Content" -Recurse -Filter '*.umap' -File
foreach ($m in $maps) { Copy-Item $m.FullName "$($m.FullName).phi-backup-363" -Force; Write-Output ("MAP BACKED UP: " + $m.FullName) }
$gamePaths = $maps | ForEach-Object { $rel = $_.FullName.Substring(("$base\Content").Length).Replace('\','/'); "'/Game" + $rel.Replace('.umap','') + "'" }
$mapListPy = '[' + ($gamePaths -join ', ') + ']'
Write-Output ("MAPS IN CENSUS: " + $gamePaths.Count)
$py = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$py = $py.Replace('MAPLIST', $mapListPy).Replace('OUTFILE', "'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\phi_mapfix_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_mapfix.py" -Value $py -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_mapfix_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$uproj = Get-ChildItem $base -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_mapfix.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\mapfix363.log"
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_mapfix_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_mapfix_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO MAPFIX OUTPUT FILE' }
Write-Output 'JOB 363 DONE'
```
